import pathlib,json,sys,math,itertools
from collections import Counter
import sympy as s
from sympy.matrices.normalforms import hermite_normal_form
R=pathlib.Path(r'C:\Repos\Theory of Everything');d=json.loads((R/'data/w33_20261031_signed_cubic_lift.json').read_text())
p=[g['permutation']for g in d['signed_generators']];co={tuple(r['triple']):r['coefficient']for r in d['coefficient_rows']}
def word(w):
 P=list(range(27));L=[Counter()for _ in range(27)]
 for j in w:
  for i in range(27):L[i][27*j+P[i]]+=1
  P=[p[j][i]for i in P]
 return P,L
rows=[];rhs=[];desc=[]
for row in d['real_sign_section']['contradiction_rows']:
 x=row['description'];v=[0]*162
 if x['kind']=='cubic':
  j=x['generator'];t=tuple(x['triple'])
  for i in t:v[27*j+i]+=1
  b=int(co[t]!=co[tuple(sorted(p[j][i]for i in t))])
 else:
  P,L=word(x['left_word']);Q,K=word(x['right_word']);assert P==Q
  i=x['coordinate']
  for j,a in L[i].items():v[j]+=a
  for j,a in K[i].items():v[j]-=a
  b=0
 rows.append(v);rhs.append(b);desc.append(x)
print('rows',len(rows),flush=True)
A=s.Matrix(rows);b=s.Matrix(rhs)
print('ranks',A.rank(),A.row_join(b).rank(),flush=True)
ns=A.T.nullspace();vals=[]
for v in ns:
 v=v*s.ilcm(*[s.denom(x)for x in v]);v=v/s.igcd(*[int(x)for x in v]);k=int((v.T*b)[0]);vals.append(k)
 if k%2:
  out=dict(rows=rows,rhs=rhs,descriptions=desc,integer_relation=list(map(int,v)),contradiction_exponent=k)
  (R/'data/w33_20261031_complex_phase_probe.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2));print('UNIVERSAL_OBSTRUCTION',k,flush=True);break
else:print('NO_ODD_RATIONAL_KERNEL_BASIS_WITNESS',vals,flush=True)

import pathlib,json,sys,numpy as np,time
R=pathlib.Path(r'C:\Repos\Theory of Everything');sys.path.insert(0,str(R/'analysis'))
from w33_20261031_signed_cubic_lift import solve2
d=json.loads((R/'data/w33_20261031_signed_cubic_lift.json').read_text());p=[g['permutation']for g in d['signed_generators']];bits=np.array([g['sign_bits']for g in d['signed_generators']],dtype=int);tri=[r['triple']for r in d['coefficient_rows']]
A=np.zeros((45,27),dtype=int)
for j,t in enumerate(tri):A[j,t]=1
rr=0;piv=[]
for c in range(27):
 k=next((k for k in range(rr,len(A))if A[k,c]%2),None)
 if k is None:continue
 A[[rr,k]]=A[[k,rr]];A[rr]=A[rr]*pow(int(A[rr,c]),-1,4)%4
 for k in range(len(A)):
  if k!=rr:A[k]=(A[k]-A[k,c]*A[rr])%4
 piv.append(c);rr+=1
assert not A[rr:].any();free=[c for c in range(27)if c not in piv];N=np.zeros((27,len(free)),dtype=int)
for j,c in enumerate(free):
 N[c,j]=1
 for r,k in enumerate(piv):N[k,j]=-A[r,c]%4
print('torus parameters per generator',len(free),flush=True)
n=6*len(free);basis={};even=[];rows=0;bad=False
def add(a,b):
 global rows,bad
 rows+=1;a=a.copy()%4;b=int(b)%4
 for c,(u,v)in basis.items():
  if a[c]:f=int(a[c]);a=(a-f*u)%4;b=(b-f*v)%4
 c=next((c for c in range(n)if a[c]%2),None)
 if c is not None:
  f=pow(int(a[c]),-1,4);a=a*f%4;b=b*f%4;basis[c]=(a,b)
 elif np.any(a):even.append((a,b))
 elif b:bad=True
identity=tuple(range(27));words={identity:(np.zeros((27,n),dtype=int),np.zeros(27,dtype=int))};queue=[identity]
for q in queue:
 L,b=words[q]
 for j,g in enumerate(p):
  pp=tuple(g[q[i]]for i in range(27));K=L.copy();K[:,j*6:(j+1)*6]+=N[list(q)];K%=4;c=(b+2*bits[j,list(q)])%4
  if pp not in words:words[pp]=(K,c);queue.append(pp)
  else:
   M,e=words[pp]
   for a,z in zip((K-M)%4,(e-c)%4):add(a,z)
 if bad:break
print('rows',rows,'rank_unit',len(basis),'even',len(even),'bad',bad,'groupseen',len(words),flush=True)
binary=[]
for a,b in even:
 for c,(u,v)in basis.items():
  if a[c]:f=int(a[c]);a=(a-f*u)%4;b=(b-f*v)%4
 if b%2:bad=True;break
 assert not np.any(a%2)
 binary.append((sum((int(a[i])//2)<<i for i in range(n)),b//2))
solution=None if bad else solve2(binary,n)
if solution is not None:
 x=np.array(solution,dtype=int)
 for c,(a,b)in reversed(list(basis.items())):x[c]=(b-int(a@x))%4
 phases=(2*bits+np.column_stack([N@x[j*6:(j+1)*6]for j in range(6)]).T)%4
 print('MOD4_SECTION_FOUND',phases.tolist(),flush=True)
 (R/'data/w33_20261031_complex_mod4_probe.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(phases=phases.tolist(),torus_null_basis=N.tolist(),parameters=x.tolist()),indent=2))
else:print('MOD4_SECTION_ABSENT',flush=True)

R=pathlib.Path(r'C:\Repos\Theory of Everything');d=json.loads((R/'data/w33_20261031_signed_cubic_lift.json').read_text());gens=[g['permutation']for g in d['signed_generators']];co={tuple(r['triple']):r['coefficient']for r in d['coefficient_rows']}
byv={v:[t for t in co if v in t]for v in range(1,11)};rows=[];rhs=[];desc=[]
for gi,g in enumerate(gens):
 vectors={}
 for v,ts in byv.items():
  ts=[t for t in ts if 0 not in t];assert len(ts)==4;records=[]
  for t in ts:
   spin=[i for i in t if i>=11];assert len(spin)==2
   r=[0]*16
   for i in spin:r[i-11]+=1;r[g[i]-11]-=1
   b=int(co[t]!=co[tuple(sorted(g[i]for i in t))]);records.append((r,b,t))
  r0,b0,t0=records[0];vectors[v]=(r0,b0,t0)
  for r,b,t in records[1:]:rows.append([a-c for a,c in zip(r,r0)]);rhs.append((b0-b)%2);desc.append(dict(kind='same_vector',generator=gi,left=t,right=t0))
 for t in co:
  if 0 not in t:continue
  v,w=[i for i in t if i];r,b,tv=vectors[v];u,c,tw=vectors[w];bt=int(co[t]!=co[tuple(sorted(g[i]for i in t))]);rows.append([a+c for a,c in zip(r,u)]);rhs.append((bt-b-c)%2);desc.append(dict(kind='singlet',generator=gi,triple=t,vector_terms=[tv,tw]))
A=s.Matrix(rows);b=s.Matrix(rhs);print('shape',A.shape,'ranks',A.rank(),A.row_join(b).rank(),flush=True)
for z in A.T.nullspace():
 z=z*s.ilcm(*[s.denom(x)for x in z]);gcd=s.igcd(*[int(x)for x in z]);z=z/gcd;k=int((z.T*b)[0])
 if k%2:
  print('UNIVERSAL_COMPLEX_PHASE_OBSTRUCTION',k,'support',sum(x!=0 for x in z),flush=True)
  out=dict(rows=rows,rhs=rhs,descriptions=desc,integer_relation=list(map(int,z)),odd_exponent=k)
  (R/'data/w33_20261031_universal_phase_probe.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2));break
else:
 print('NO_ODD_KERNEL_BASIS_FOUND',flush=True)
 from sympy.matrices.normalforms import hermite_normal_form
 H=hermite_normal_form(A.row_join(b).T);v=H[:-1,:].nullspace()[0];v=v*s.ilcm(*[s.denom(x)for x in v]);v=v/s.igcd(*[int(x)for x in v]);print('lattice_axis_generator',int((H*v)[-1]),flush=True)
 sys.path.insert(0,str(R/'analysis'))
 from w33_20261031_signed_cubic_lift import solve2
 vs=[]
 for z in A.T.nullspace():
  z=z*s.ilcm(*[s.denom(x)for x in z]);z=z/s.igcd(*[int(x)for x in z]);vs.append(z)
 V=s.Matrix.hstack(*vs);ks=[int((z.T*b)[0])for z in vs];assert all(k%2==0 for k in ks)
 equations=[(sum((int(V[i,j])%2)<<j for j in range(V.cols)),0)for i in range(V.rows)]+[(sum(((k//2)%2)<<j for j,k in enumerate(ks)),1)]
 comb=solve2(equations,V.cols)
 if comb is not None:
  z=V*s.Matrix(comb)/2;assert all(s.denom(x)==1 for x in z);k=int((z.T*b)[0]);assert k%2
  print('SATURATED_UNIVERSAL_OBSTRUCTION',k,'support',sum(x!=0 for x in z),flush=True)
  (R/'data/w33_20261031_universal_phase_probe.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(rows=rows,rhs=rhs,descriptions=desc,integer_relation=list(map(int,z)),odd_exponent=k),indent=2))
 import numpy as np
 def modular(A,b,m):
  A=np.array(A,dtype=int)%m;b=np.array(b,dtype=int)%m;n=A.shape[1];r=0;piv=[]
  for c in range(n):
   k=next((k for k in range(r,len(A))if A[k,c]%2),None)
   if k is None:continue
   A[[r,k]]=A[[k,r]];b[[r,k]]=b[[k,r]];iv=pow(int(A[r,c]),-1,m);A[r]=A[r]*iv%m;b[r]=b[r]*iv%m
   for k in range(len(A)):
    if k!=r:
     f=int(A[k,c]);A[k]=(A[k]-f*A[r])%m;b[k]=(b[k]-f*b[r])%m
   piv.append(c);r+=1
  free=[c for c in range(n)if c not in piv];x=np.zeros(n,dtype=int)
  if any(b[r:]%2):return None
  if m>2 and r<len(A):
   child=modular(A[r:,free]//2,b[r:]//2,m//2)
   if child is None:return None
   x[free]=child
  elif np.any(b[r:]):return None
  for j,c in enumerate(piv):x[c]=(b[j]-A[j]@x)%m
  return x
 for m in (4,8,16,32):
  z=modular(rows,[m//2*b for b in rhs],m)
  if z is not None:
   print('GAUGE_SOLUTION',m,z.tolist(),flush=True)
   (R/'data/w33_20261031_complex_gauge_probe.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(modulus=m,gauge_exponents=z.tolist(),rows=rows,rhs=rhs,descriptions=desc),indent=2));break

import pathlib,sys,json,itertools,collections,time
import numpy as np,networkx as nx
R=pathlib.Path(r'C:\Repos\Theory of Everything');sys.path.insert(0,str(R/'analysis'))
import w33_pass11177_perfect_gates_tritangent as T
import w33_pass11156_perfect_spacetime_gates as G
t0=time.time();_,facs=T.factorisations();facs=sorted(facs,key=lambda f:sorted(sorted(P)for P in f));octs=[frozenset().union(*f)for f in facs]
A=nx.Graph();A.add_nodes_from(range(45));A.add_edges_from((i,j)for i,j in itertools.combinations(range(45),2)if not octs[i]&octs[j]);frames=sorted(tuple(sorted(c))for c in nx.find_cliques(A)if len(c)==5);assert len(frames)==27
fset=frozenset(frames[0]);part={octs[i]for i in fset};oid={o:i for i,o in enumerate(octs)};fid={frozenset(f):i for i,f in enumerate(frames)}
pts=np.array(T.PTS);acts={};matrices={}
for S in G.sp43():
 raw=pts@S.T%3;first=np.argmax(raw!=0,axis=1);raw=raw*raw[np.arange(40),first,None]%3;pp=[T.PID[tuple(v)]for v in raw]
 if {frozenset(pp[i]for i in octs[j])for j in fset}!=part:continue
 fp=[oid[frozenset(pp[i]for i in o)]for o in octs];perm=tuple(fid[frozenset(fp[i]for i in f)]for f in frames)
 k=tuple(int(x)for x in S.flat);acts[k]=perm
 canon=tuple(int(x)for x in (S*next(int(x)for x in S.flat if x)%3).flat);matrices[perm]=np.array(canon).reshape(4,4)
print('q3preimage',len(acts),'quotient',len(matrices),'seconds',time.time()-t0,flush=True)
assert len(acts)==1920 and len(matrices)==960
FG=nx.Graph();FG.add_nodes_from(range(27));FG.add_edges_from((i,j)for i,j in itertools.combinations(range(27),2)if set(frames[i])&set(frames[j]))
old=json.loads((R/'data/w33_20261031_petersen_stabilizer.json').read_text());cd=json.loads((R/'data/w33_20261031_signed_cubic_lift.json').read_text());trip=[r['triple']for r in cd['coefficient_rows']]
WG=nx.Graph();WG.add_nodes_from(range(27));WG.add_edges_from((a,b)for t in trip for a,b in itertools.combinations(t,2))
for H in (FG,WG):nx.set_node_attributes(H,{i:int(i==0)for i in H},'anchor')
mapping=next(nx.isomorphism.GraphMatcher(WG,FG,node_match=lambda a,b:a['anchor']==b['anchor']).isomorphisms_iter());mi={v:k for k,v in mapping.items()}
q3gens=[]
for g in cd['signed_generators']:
 p=g['permutation'];conj=tuple(mapping[p[mi[i]]]for i in range(27));assert conj in matrices;q3gens.append(matrices[conj])
print('six projective generators transported',flush=True)
q5gens=[np.array(x)for x in old['symplectic_matrix_generators']];key=lambda M:tuple(map(int,M.flat));I=np.eye(4,dtype=int)
words={key(I):(I,0)};queue=[I];equations=[]
for B in queue:
 C,bits=words[key(B)]
 for j,(g,h)in enumerate(zip(q5gens,q3gens)):
  D=g@B%5;E=h@C%3;nbits=bits^(1<<j);k=key(D)
  if k not in words:words[k]=(E,nbits);queue.append(D)
  else:
   F,fb=words[k];sign=0 if np.array_equal(E,F)else 1
   assert sign==0 or np.array_equal(E,-F%3)
   equations.append((nbits^fb,sign))
assert len(queue)==1920
from w33_20261031_signed_cubic_lift import solve2
C,bits=words[key(-I%5)];sgn=0 if np.array_equal(C,-I%3)else 1;assert sgn==0 or np.array_equal(C,I)
equations.append((bits,sgn));sol=solve2(equations,6)
print('CENTRAL_EXTENSION_EQUIVALENT',sol is not None,sol,flush=True)
out=dict(frame_indices=frames,frame_octets=[sorted(octs[i])for i in frames[0]],q3_point_coordinates=T.PTS,weight_to_frame=[mapping[i]for i in range(27)],q3_matrix_generators=[x.tolist()for x in q3gens],projective_generator_permutations=[g['permutation']for g in cd['signed_generators']],q3_preimage_order=len(acts),projective_order=len(matrices),extension_equivalent=sol is not None,extension_generator_signs=sol)
(R/'data/w33_20261031_q3_q5_probe.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2,default=int))

import pathlib,json,itertools,time,numpy as np
from ortools.sat.python import cp_model
R=pathlib.Path(r'C:\Repos\Theory of Everything')
out=[]
for q in (3,5,7,11,19,23,31):
 squares={a*a%q for a in range(1,q)};P=[(1,a,b)for a,b in itertools.product(range(q),repeat=2)]+[(0,1,a)for a in range(q)]+[(0,0,1)]
 E=[p for p in P if(p[1]*p[1]-p[0]*p[2])%q in squares];L=[l for l in P if(l[1]*l[1]-4*l[0]*l[2])%q not in squares|{0}]
 H=np.array(L)@np.array(E).T%q==0;n=(q+1)//2
 assert H.shape==(q*(n-1),q*n)and np.all(H.sum(0)==n-1)and np.all(H.sum(1)==n)
 basis={}
 for row in H:
  a=sum(1<<int(i)for i in np.flatnonzero(row))
  while a:
   i=a.bit_length()-1
   if i not in basis:basis[i]=a;break
   a^=basis[i]
 model=cp_model.CpModel();xs=[model.NewBoolVar(f'x{i}')for i in range(len(E))]
 for row in H:model.AddBoolXOr([xs[int(i)]for i in np.flatnonzero(row)]+[True])
 model.Add(sum(xs)==n);model.Add(xs[0]==1)
 solver=cp_model.CpSolver();solver.parameters.max_time_in_seconds=30;solver.parameters.num_search_workers=4;t=time.time();status=solver.Solve(model)
 chosen=[i for i,x in enumerate(xs)if solver.Value(x)]if status in(cp_model.OPTIMAL,cp_model.FEASIBLE)else[]
 row=dict(q=q,shape=list(H.shape),binary_rank=len(basis),kernel_dimension=len(E)-len(basis),bound=n,status=solver.StatusName(status),chosen_points=[E[i]for i in chosen],seconds=time.time()-t);out.append(row);print(row,flush=True)
(R/'data/w33_20261031_conic_code_probe.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2))
